ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
